status: defined before new paid acceptance calls
scope: synthetic methodological acceptance, not real RSD operations or business impact
independent_oracle: source documents and assertions below; generator/verifier approval alone is insufficient
common: Preserve the natural initial statement; additional documents enter only after initial Discovery or a matching factual question.
Every factual assertion must be supported by the released source contents; a reference handle alone is not proof.
No primary bottleneck, central-system deficit, causal relation or guaranteed improvement asserted without a source establishing it; hypotheses remain explicitly conditional in all fields.
The process scope covers the focus phase and its reported substeps, not the entire value stream.
A blocking clarification remains decision-blocking, including saved historical approved analyses; exploration stays available.
A discovered error is corrected by the existing bounded repair and independently revalidated; unavailable facts cause a precise question or deferral.
Generated options compare organizational action, existing standard software/classical rules and optional AI against the same diagnosis; benefits remain unproven unless a source establishes them.
No invented human approval, confirmed production cause, numerical business baseline, pilot effect or preferred solution.

A.release: on questions about information/example/current workflow, then source comparison
expected_known: one simple case needs no internal inquiry
unacceptable: search causes contradictory entries as a fact
missing central system as established cause
confirmed current time selected from chronology alone
A.justified_endpoint: explicitly provisional diagnosis/options or targeted factual clarification; no committed solution

B.release: on questions about process, workload, scope or available sources
expected_known: new staff are constrained but not forbidden
unacceptable: all hiring is excluded as a fact
sales or booking entry is the established bottleneck
B.justified_endpoint: defer focus/solution preference pending comparative process evidence

C.release: on questions about conflicting documents, contact or message authority
expected_known: original travel sheet and later message conflict
phone number exists but reachability untested
unacceptable: no contact details exist as a fact
contact preparation equals resolved customer outcome
C.justified_endpoint: prepare a conditional organizational clarification path; do not decide the actual meeting point

D.release: on questions about participants, confirmations, authority or concrete change
expected_known: bus feasibility is conditional on unresolved price
local partner may request offers only
unacceptable: central platform missing as established cause
local partner authorized to order without evidence
D.justified_endpoint: ask who may approve/order; conditional organizational confirmation process as full alternative

historical_faults_to_reject: A focus.rationale: search is primary bottleneck causing contradictory information
B facts: continuous hiring excluded; clarification blocking=true with approved verifier
C process.exceptions: no contact details; full value-stream scope copied into focused process
D process.bottlenecks: missing central confirmation record as fact without evidence; no authority question
